title: SkillEval: Decomposing Agent Skill Quality into Interpretable Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.06891v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent skills provide reusable knowledge that helps agents solve specialized tasks. As their use expands, evaluating skill quality becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations often measure skill quality based on improvements in agent performance on specific tasks. However, a reusable skill may apply across multiple scenarios. Evaluation on a single downstream task mainly reflects the compatibility between a skill and the evaluated task, provides only a partial view of skill quality, and does not identify which aspects need improvement. We find that general properties of the \texttt{SKILL.md} document play an important role in skill quality. To evaluate these properties, we propose \textbf{SkillEval}, an interpretable framework for document-level skill evaluation. translated_title: SkillEval：将智能体技能质量分解为可解释的信号
translated_abstract: 智能体技能提供可复用的知识，帮助智能体解决专门化任务。随着其应用的不断扩展，评估技能质量变得越来越重要。现有评估方法通常基于智能体在特定任务上的性能提升来衡量技能质量。然而，一个可复用的技能可能适用于多个场景，仅针对单一下游任务的评估主要反映的是技能与该任务之间的兼容性，只能提供技能质量的部分视角，且无法识别哪些方面需要改进。我们发现 SKILL.md 文档的通用属性对技能质量起着重要作用。为了评估这些属性，我们提出了 SkillEval，一个用于文档级技能评估的可解释框架。SkillEval 使用固定且可检查的评分方向，为每个属性生成可解释的分数，并进一步测量和降低无关文档的影响。
tldr: 提出 SkillEval 框架，将智能体技能质量分解为 SKILL.md 文档级别的可解释属性信号，克服了传统单一下游任务评估只能反映技能与任务兼容性的局限。
en_tdlr: SkillEval proposes an interpretable framework that decomposes agent skill quality into document-level interpretable property signals of SKILL.md, overcoming the limitation that single downstream task evaluation only reflects skill-task compatibility.
